cues.text: A massive gas giant fills the starry void. Its atmosphere is a swirling mass of deep crimson and glowing red embers.
A brilliant pink star flares from behind the planet, casting light across wide, sweeping rings of ice.
A pale crescent moon hangs in the dark. Below it, a tiny point of light, the colony ship, streaks over the rings.
It descends toward the burning clouds.

beats.note: A large red gas giant with bright glowing red patches and thick rings.
A bright pink star shines from behind the planet.
A crescent moon is visible in the distant background.
A tiny point of light appears, moving across the rings.
The colony ship continues its descent towards the red planet.
